rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Devices to Set Rents or Manage Occupancy
rules.requirement: Landlords and other entities may not sell or use algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. Tenants or the City Attorney may bring a civil action if they believe an entity is violating the law.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential units in San Francisco.

rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violation of the law.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
